title: Spiral Matrix (harder)
prompt:
In this project directory, implement a Python module named spiral_matrix.py with one function:
  - spiral(n: int) -> list[list[int]] : returns an n x n matrix (as a list of n lists, each of length n) filled with the integers 1..n*n in clockwise spiral order, starting at the top-left corner and spiraling inward. n=0 returns an empty list []. Raise ValueError for n < 0.
There is already a hidden reference test suite at tests/test_spiral_matrix.py -- do NOT modify it. Your Testing phase should run `pytest tests -q` (in addition to any tests you write yourself) and every test must pass. Also add a short README.md explaining the spiral rule with a small example.
